# AutoSmartCode

> Web scraping, automation, data pipelines and web development for US
> businesses. Run by Sam. Fixed prices quoted within 24 hours, most projects
> delivered in 2–5 days. Contact: sam@autosmartcode.com

AutoSmartCode builds custom software rather than selling a product: scrapers
written against specific target sites, automation pipelines for car dealers and
wholesalers, verified B2B lead lists, and websites for small businesses. Every
build is quoted at a fixed price before work starts.

## Services

- [Car Auction Automation for Dealers and Wholesalers](https://www.autosmartcode.com/services/car-auction-automation): Automated auction data for dealers and wholesalers. Pull run lists from Manheim, ADESA, ACV or the private dealer portal you actually buy on, scored against MMR daily.
- [Vehicle History Report Automation — Carfax, AutoCheck and VIN Data](https://www.autosmartcode.com/services/vehicle-history-reports): Stop pulling car history reports one VIN at a time. Bulk VIN decoding, automated report retrieval through your own Carfax or AutoCheck dealer account, and every result parsed into one spreadsheet.
- [Car Dealer Inventory Scraping — AutoTrader, CarMax, Cars.com and More](https://www.autosmartcode.com/services/dealer-inventory-scraping): Scrape live dealer inventory and vehicle listings from AutoTrader, CarMax, Cars.com, CarGurus, AutoScout24 and Carsales. Every listing, price, VIN and photo in one clean spreadsheet, refreshed daily.
- [Business Leads Data & B2B Lead Scraping Services](https://www.autosmartcode.com/services/business-leads-data): Custom B2B lead lists built to your exact criteria from Google Maps, LinkedIn, Yelp and industry directories. Verified emails and phones, no recycled databases, delivered in days.
- [Web Scraping Services for US, UK & International Businesses](https://www.autosmartcode.com/services/web-scraping): Custom web scraping and data extraction for any website. Products, prices, listings, leads and reviews delivered as clean Excel, CSV or database rows. Fixed price, quoted in 24 hours.
- [Web Development Services — Sites, Stores and Dashboards](https://www.autosmartcode.com/services/web-development): Fast, modern websites, eCommerce stores and internal dashboards built with React and Next.js. Built to load quickly, rank well and convert — by the developer who writes the code.

## Sites scraped (one page per platform)

- [AutoTrader Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/autotrader-scraper): Custom AutoTrader scraper that pulls every matching listing daily — VIN, price, mileage, trim, dealer and photos — into one clean spreadsheet. Built in days, fixed price.
- [AutoScout24 Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/autoscout24-scraper): AutoScout24 scraper for dealers and traders. Extract listings, prices, mileage and dealer details across Germany, Italy, Netherlands and every AutoScout24 market into one dataset.
- [CarMax Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/carmax-scraper): CarMax scraper pulling live nationwide inventory — VIN, no-haggle price, mileage, trim, store location and transfer availability — into a clean daily dataset.
- [Carsales Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/carsales-scraper): Carsales.com.au scraper for Australian dealers and traders. Pull listings, prices, kilometres, dealer details and state-level market data into one refreshed dataset.
- [Cars.com Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/cars-com-scraper): Cars.com scraper that captures every matching listing — VIN, price, deal rating, mileage, dealer and photos — refreshed daily into Excel, Sheets or your database.
- [CarGurus Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/cargurus-scraper): CarGurus scraper capturing listings, instant market value, deal ratings, price history and dealer reputation data across any US market, refreshed on your schedule.
- [Manheim MMR Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/manheim-mmr-scraper): Automate Manheim MMR lookups against your own dealer account. Bulk VIN valuations, run-list scoring and a ranked deal email before the lane opens.
- [Google Maps Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/google-maps-scraper): Google Maps scraper that builds verified B2B lead lists — name, phone, email, website, rating and reviews — for any category in any city. 5,000 leads in about 24 hours.
- [MediaMarkt Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/mediamarkt-scraper): MediaMarkt scraper for price monitoring and catalogue data across Germany, Spain, Italy and every MediaMarkt market. Prices, stock, specs and promotions, refreshed daily.
- [ADESA Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/adesa-scraper): Automate ADESA run lists, condition grades and sale calendars through your own dealer account. Every lot scored against MMR and delivered before the sale starts.
- [BacklotCars Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/backlotcars-scraper): Automate BacklotCars inventory, buy-now pricing and offer data through your own account. Every listing scored against market value and delivered as a ranked daily shortlist.
- [OpenLane Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/openlane-scraper): Automate OpenLane listings, condition reports and pricing through your own dealer account. Every lot scored against market value in one ranked daily shortlist.
- [ACV Auctions Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/acv-auctions-scraper): Automate ACV Auctions listings, condition reports and inspection data through your own dealer account. Every lot scored against your buy box before the timer runs down.
- [Copart Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/copart-scraper): Copart scraper for rebuilders, exporters and parts buyers. Pull lot details, damage type, run-and-drive status, estimated retail value and sale dates into one dataset.
- [EDGE Pipeline Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/edge-pipeline-scraper): Automate EDGE Pipeline and Simulcast run lists from the independent auctions you buy at. Every sale, every lane, scored against your buy box in one overnight pass.
- [SmartAuction Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/smartauction-scraper): Automate Ally SmartAuction listings, condition reports and buy-now pricing through your own dealer account. Off-lease inventory scored against your buy box daily.
- [Private Dealer Marketplace & Auction Portal Scraping](https://www.autosmartcode.com/dealer-marketplace-scraper): Most dealers and wholesalers buy on a platform nobody else has heard of. If you can log into it, it can be automated — run lists, pricing and condition data, scored daily.
- [eBay Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/ebay-scraper): eBay scraper for resellers and brands. Extract active listings, sold prices, seller data and category trends into one dataset. Sold-listing history is the real prize.
- [Amazon Product Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/amazon-product-scraper): Amazon scraper pulling product data, prices, BSR, Buy Box ownership, reviews and seller info at scale. For product research, repricing and brand monitoring.
- [Walmart Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/walmart-scraper): Walmart scraper for price monitoring and product research. Multi-keyword parallel extraction of prices, stock, seller and rating data into one clean daily dataset.
- [AutoCheck Report Automation — Bulk VIN History Pulls](https://www.autosmartcode.com/autocheck-scraper): Pull AutoCheck history reports for a whole run list through your own dealer account. Score, comparison range, title brands and announcements as columns, not 400 PDFs.
- [Carfax Report Automation — Bulk Vehicle History by VIN](https://www.autosmartcode.com/carfax-scraper): Run a whole VIN list through your own Carfax dealer account and get accidents, service records, owner count and title brands as spreadsheet columns instead of PDFs.
- [AutoNation Inventory Scraper — Dealer Group Listing Data](https://www.autosmartcode.com/autonation-scraper): Track AutoNation's published inventory across every rooftop — VIN, price, mileage, trim, store and days listed — in one refreshed spreadsheet. Works for any dealer group.
- [Otomoto Scraper](https://www.autosmartcode.com/otomoto-scraper): Custom Otomoto scraper pulling every matching Polish and Central European listing — price, mileage, VIN where shown, dealer and photos — into one clean spreadsheet.

## Guides

- [What Is Web Scraping? A Complete Beginner's Guide](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/what-is-web-scraping): Everything you need to know about web scraping — what it is, how it works, and how businesses use it to get a competitive edge.
- [Is Web Scraping Legal? What US Businesses Need to Know](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/is-web-scraping-legal): A plain-English guide to the rules around scraping — what courts have actually decided, what's clearly safe, what's risky, and how to stay on the right side of the line.
- [How Much Does Web Scraping Cost? Real Prices for Custom Scrapers](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/how-much-does-web-scraping-cost): What a web scraping service actually costs — by complexity, volume and delivery model — with real price bands, plus the hidden costs nobody quotes you upfront.
- [How Car Dealers Can Automate Manheim MMR Price Checks](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/automate-manheim-mmr): Stop checking MMR prices manually. Here's how to build an automated system that pulls live auction data and emails you profitable deals every morning.
- [How to Scrape 5,000 Business Leads from Google Maps](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/scrape-google-maps-leads): A practical guide to extracting business names, phone numbers, emails, and addresses from Google Maps for any niche and location.
- [5 Python Automations Every Small Business Should Have](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/python-automation-small-business): The most impactful automation projects for US small businesses — each one saves at least 5 hours per week and pays for itself quickly.
- [How to Use AI to Analyze Amazon Reviews and Beat Competitors](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/amazon-product-analysis-ai): Use AI-powered review analysis to find exactly what customers hate about competitor products — then fix those things in yours.
- [How Real Estate Investors Use Scraping to Find Better Deals](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/zillow-airbnb-real-estate-scraping): Scraping Zillow, Redfin, and Airbnb gives real estate investors data their competitors don't have — here's how it works.
- [Why Your Scraper Keeps Getting Blocked (And How to Fix It)](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/bypass-captcha-anti-bot-scraping): The real reasons sites detect scrapers — browser fingerprints, request patterns, TLS signatures — and the practical fixes that actually work.
- [Competitor Price Monitoring: The Complete Setup Guide](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/ecommerce-price-monitoring-automation): How online sellers track competitor pricing automatically, react within minutes instead of days, and stop leaving margin on the table.
- [Free VIN Decoding: What NHTSA's vPIC API Actually Gives You](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/free-vin-decoder-nhtsa-api): There is a US government API that decodes any VIN for free, with no key, no rate limit and no licensing. Most dealers are paying for data they could get from it.
- [How to Price Used Cars Against the Live Market, Not a Book Value](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/price-used-cars-market-data): Book values tell you what a car was worth. Live listing data tells you what buyers in your market are being asked to pay for it today. Here is how to build the second one.
- [Using AI to Clean Up Messy Scraped Data (And When Not To)](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/ai-parsing-scraped-data): Language models are very good at the parsing problems that used to need a hundred regexes — and a bad, expensive choice for the ones a regex already solves.
- [Self-Healing Scrapers: What AI Fixes When a Site Changes, and What It Doesn't](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/self-healing-scrapers-ai): Every scraper eventually breaks because a site redesigns. AI can genuinely repair some of those breaks automatically — and pretending it fixes all of them is how you end up with silently wrong data.
- [Why Your Cold Email List Bounces (And What It Costs You)](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/why-cold-email-lists-bounce): A 30% bounce rate does not just waste 30% of your list. It damages your sending domain in ways that outlast the campaign — often permanently.
- [What a Slow Website Actually Costs a Small Business](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/slow-website-cost-small-business): Every second your site takes to load, a share of your visitors leave — and they never tell you they were there. Here is where the time goes and what it is worth fixing.
- [What Is MMR? The Manheim Market Report Explained for Dealers](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/what-is-mmr-manheim-market-report): MMR is the number the whole wholesale market quietly agrees a car is worth. Here is what it actually measures, how to read it, and where it stops being enough on its own.
- [How to Automate Your Used-Car Merchandising Workflow](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/automate-car-merchandising-workflow): From auction win to a live, priced, photographed listing is a dozen manual steps most dealers still do by hand. Here is which parts genuinely automate, which do not, and where tools like Spyne fit.
- [AutoCheck vs Carfax: Which History Report, and How to Automate Both](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/autocheck-vs-carfax-vehicle-history): Two reports, two different pictures of the same car, and dealers who run at volume usually need both. What each one is actually better at — and how to pull them without a person doing it VIN by VIN.
- [What Is an AutoCheck Report? The Score, the History, and How to Read One](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/what-is-an-autocheck-report): AutoCheck is the vehicle history report built into the auction lanes — and the only one that gives a car a single comparable number. What is actually in it, what the AutoCheck Score does and does not mean, and where it goes quiet.
- [AutoScraper: What the Python Library Does, and When It Is Not Enough](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/autoscraper-python-library-vs-custom-scraper): AutoScraper learns a page's structure from an example instead of a selector, and for the right job it is genuinely the fastest way to get data out of a site. Here is what it does well, the four things that break it, and how to tell which side of that line you are on.
- [How Fuel Prices Move Used Vehicle Values — and How to Track It in MMR](https://www.autosmartcode.com/blog/fuel-prices-used-vehicle-values): Fuel prices really do reprice a lot, but not evenly, not immediately, and not symmetrically. What actually moves, how long it takes to reach the block, and the four numbers to watch so you find out from your own data instead of from a bad appraisal.
